purpose: Machine-readable composition/safe-zone study for already-staged W07 progression artwork. This is a non-runtime visual handoff for Workstream 15; it neither integrates assets nor changes gameplay/state.

reference.referenceBoundary: Desktop Home original is authoritative. 390x844 and 320x568 are reachability/readability verification sizes only; no phone screenshot parity is claimed.

regionSemantics.MUST_KEEP: Do not crop this semantic group when the decorative asset is shown.
regionSemantics.SUPPORTING: May lose limited peripheral breathing room only after MUST_KEEP content remains intact.
regionSemantics.OPTIONAL: Ambient sparkle/glow/floor breathing room that may be reduced before stateful UI is compressed.

coordinateSystem.measurementNote: Bounds are producer composition guides derived from the versioned SVG geometry, with conservative padding around transformed groups. They are not machine approval thresholds and do not replace actual target-surface pixel review.

globalIntegrationPolicy.liveStatePriority: Real labels, counters, mastery evidence, ownership, prices and actions stay outside decorative art and take layout priority over decoration.
globalIntegrationPolicy.narrowViewportRule: If the available slot cannot show the complete MUST_KEEP union at readable scale, shrink or omit the decorative image rather than crop a semantic station or obscure live state.
globalIntegrationPolicy.overflowRule: Artwork must remain inside its assigned panel and must not refill the W13/15 Home hero corridor or create horizontal overflow.

assets.semanticConstraint: Exactly three neutral stations must remain legible; no station may be cropped into an apparent completed/selected state.
Open-book learning metaphor remains dominant; geometry/pencil support it without implying a score, answer or subject percentage.
Medallion is symbolic only; it must not visually substitute for the real mastered-skill or Mastery Star state.
Wardrobe, room-style station and parcel remain a neutral customization/reward metaphor; no depicted swatch, garment or parcel becomes a claimed owned catalog item or earned reward.

viewportGuidance.1408x1056: Show full decorative composition inside existing panel envelope; preserve reference hierarchy and keep W07 art subordinate to room/hero/Dream Goal.
viewportGuidance.1024x768: Keep full MUST_KEEP union with contain-first scaling; reduce decorative height before live copy or controls.
viewportGuidance.390x844: Do not convert to cover crop. If the art becomes too small to contribute, collapse/omit decoration while leaving live state/action reachable.
viewportGuidance.320x568: Treat decoration as expendable. Never crop Daily into fewer than three stations, never hide real state, and never introduce horizontal scroll to preserve the image.

handoff.use: Shared visual-finishing evaluation and eventual integration planning only.
